# SurfaceTrace imagery

`01.gif`–`06.gif` and their poster PNGs are SurfaceTrace method visualizations made from split-specific KolektorSDD photographs and model intermediates. The SurfaceTrace team created these animations; they contain dataset-derived imagery.

Source: [KolektorSDD, ViCoS Lab / Kolektor Group](https://www.vicos.si/resources/kolektorsdd/). Please cite [Tabernik et al., *Journal of Intelligent Manufacturing* (2019)](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10845-019-01476-x). The dataset and dataset-derived media are presented under [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/). This research demo does not depict the partner's rubber-belt data.
